units.source_text: 很快，发长彦就来到了生驹山，

en.t: Before long, Kaminagahiko arrived at Mount Ikoma,

units.source_text: 果不其然，生驹山半山腰上真的有一个巨大的山洞，

en.t: Just as expected, halfway up Mount Ikoma there really was a huge cave,

units.source_text: 而头戴金簪面容姣好的大公主正在山洞里，掩面垂泪。

en.t: and the beautiful eldest princess, wearing a golden hairpin, was inside the cave, covering her face as tears streamed down.
